description: This Kotlin class defines an Android Fragment named AstrologyFragment used to display astrology-related information such as raasi, nakshatra, sunrise, sunset, and date selection via a date picker. It interacts with an external AstrologyService to fetch data for the selected date and updates the UI accordingly.

classes.name: AstrologyFragment
classes.description: Android Fragment for displaying astrology data, managing date selection, and interacting with AstrologyService.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and inflates the fragment's view from XML layout.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes views, sets default date, and sets up click listener for date picker.

methods.name: showDatePicker
methods.description: Displays a MaterialDatePicker for selecting a date, and updates data on selection.

methods.name: updateDateDisplay
methods.description: Formats and displays the selected date in the TextView.

methods.name: updateAstrologyDetails
methods.description: Fetches astrology data asynchronously using the AstrologyService and updates the UI. Handles exceptions by displaying error messages.
